Kumamoto Castle Climate

Kumamoto has four seasons. From July to
September as from rainy season to its summer,
it is hot and humid. From January to February, it
is windy cold and it snows in the mountain area.
In spring and fall, it is the most comfortable and
beautiful times of the year in Kumamoto.

The Kumamoto University Short-Term Exchange
Program is designed for full-time 3"¢ year foreign
undergraduate students of universities that have a
student exchange agreement with Kumamoto
University. The program offers courses on Japanese
language, Japanese and Asian society and culture,
and advanced science and technology. At Kumamoto
University, there are both half- and full-year
programs, and students retain full-time student
status at their home universities. This program
encourages promotion of cultural and academic
interactions between Kumamoto University and
partner university students

Kumamoto University has a dormitory called “Kumamoto University International House,” which is mainly
for international students and researchers from overseas. For students who come through the
Kumamoto University STEP are given priority for the International House. It has a capacity of over 200
international students. The dormitory is located about 1.5km east of the University campus, and it takes
about 10 minutes by bicycle to get to the campus.

Inside and outside of Kumamoto University, variety of events to experience
culture and interact with Japanese students are held. As examples, there are
parties held for new international students in Kumamoto Prefecture in each
semester and a yearly two-day overnight study trip to join in for interacting with
Japanese students. Furthermore, there are events held by local authorities to
interact with local residents and experience the culture.

Besides that, there are student activities that are held on or outside of the
campus vary in both sports activities and cultural activities.
